messages:
aoife: Kicking off external pentest intake for Thurs. Scope: staging cluster, metrics read-only, and an evidence S3 bucket. Need a short runbook for ephemeral RBAC, KMS grants for vendor uploads, and an audit retention plan. Anyone free for a 30m sync today?

trent: I can do 30m. Main asks: 1) ephemeral role lifecycle 2) evidence sealing (immutability) 3) retest credentialing. Prefer to codify as CFN.

lia: +1 on CFN. For sealing: plan is vendor uploads to tmp/ then a sealing lambda moves to sealed/{assessment-id}/ and applies SSE-KMS using alias/pt-evidence-cmk. We also need Object Lock (governance) on sealed prefix.

aoife: Good. Ops question: will the vendor assume an AWS role or use presigned PUTs? Both have tradeoffs.

trent: Vendor prefers AssumeRole for traceability. We'll create role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pentest-assessor-{vendor}-{ts}. Short session duration 1h. Policy allows PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/tmp/* and kms:Encrypt on the evidence key but via grant.

lia: Sample IAM policy snippet: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/tmp/*","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence"]}]}
```

infra-bot: Note: scheduled infra deploy at Thu 08:00 UTC; role CFN must be applied after that.

ops-oncall: For KMS, we'll create a temporary grant scoped to the role principal (GrantTokens optional). Command example: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pentest-assessor-{vendor}-{ts} --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name pentest-grant-{id}`. We'll record the GrantId in the tracker and revoke with `revoke-grant`.

security-bot: Reminder: enable CloudTrail log-file-validation + multi-region delivery. Turn on S3 Object Lock in Governance mode for sealed/ and set retention per SOW (default 90 days). Also tag evidence objects with assessment-id for search.

lia: We'll require vendor to set SSE-KMS with EncryptionContext {"assessment-id": "<id>"} so KMS API events include context in CloudTrail. Add a condition to policy: "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:assessment-id": "${assessment-id}"}}

trent: For retest: vendor asked for a 2-week follow-up window. Security preference: create a fresh role + grant per retest, not reuse. We'll automate name pattern and teardown.

aoife: Who signs RBAC? I'm happy to approve final policies after a brief review. Lia, can you post the CFN template?

lia: Will do. CFN will include role, inline policy, S3 bucket prefix policy, Lambda for sealing, and a KMS Grant resource created via a Custom Resource (Lambda) so we can track GrantId.

ops-oncall: Runbook items: create grant -> emit event to tracker -> enable CloudWatch metric for AssumeRole failures -> after window, revoke grant -> verify object checksums and seal logs. I'll add pager rule for excessive assume attempts.

trent: Also add an automated validation job to assert object lock and SSE-KMS on sealed prefix; fail the intake if not compliant.

aoife: Action list:
- lia: post CFN + policy snippets (owner)
- ops-oncall: grant lifecycle runbook + pager rules (owner)
- trent: add retest automation template and teardown (owner)
- aoife: create intake ticket & remediation-tracker entry, invite vendor to schedule

lia: One vendor question: can we accept streaming telemetry instead of S3 for large logs? We can accept streaming to our secure ingest but require final artifact dump to S3 sealed prefix before closure.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. Streaming allowed for live analysis; final artifacts must land in sealed/ with object-lock.

security-bot: Also require evidence checksum metadata (sha256) and put it in object metadata and tracker entry. Adds faster integrity checks during retest.

trent: OK, if no objections I'll proceed to push the CFN to a draft PR after the sync. Small note: ensure CFN uses ChangeSet and approval before apply.

aoife: Sounds good. Sync 30m calendar invite sent. I'll tag this plan into the intake ticket and mark tentative retest window preference (2 weeks). :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
